title: Secret with a known format
description: Literal with the format of a known credential. Anyone with the APK can extract it.
remediation: Revoke and rotate the credential; move access to a backend. Google keys restricted by package/signature are expected in apps.
falsePositives: Google API keys for Maps/Firebase are public by design when restricted; sample JWTs.

title: High-entropy literal (possible secret)
description: Long random-looking sequence that may be a secret. Low confidence by nature.
remediation: Find out what the value is; if it is a credential, revoke it and remove it from the app.
falsePositives: Many: hashes, base64 resource data, identifiers. Pure hexadecimal and certificate pins are ignored.

title: Literal http:// URL
description: Cleartext endpoint: if used, the traffic can be read and modified on the network.
remediation: Use HTTPS; check usesCleartextTraffic and networkSecurityConfig.
falsePositives: Documentation URLs, namespaces and local addresses.
